monsters.name: Relentless Juggernaut
monsters.description: Relentless Juggernaut from Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the juggernaut fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The juggernaut regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. If the juggernaut takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The juggernaut dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The juggernaut doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The juggernaut makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with Deadly Shaping if it is ready.

actions.name: Executioner's Pick
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the juggernaut's next turn.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Deadly Shaping (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The juggernaut magically shapes a feature of its surroundings into a deadly implement. A creature the juggernaut can see within 60 feet of it must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. If the saving throw fails, the targeted creature is struck by one of the following (juggernaut's choice):

actions.name: Flying Stone
actions.description: The target takes 22 (5d8) bludgeoning damage and is incapacitated until the start of the juggernaut's next turn, and the implement vanishes.

actions.name: Scything Shrapnel
actions.description: The target takes 14 (4d6) slashing damage, and the implement vanishes. At the start of each of its turns, the target takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage from the wound left by the shrapnel. The wound ends if the target regains any hit points or if a creature uses an action to stanch the wound, which requires a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

legendaryActions.name: Implacable Advance
legendaryActions.description: The juggernaut moves up to its speed, ignoring 3. Any object in its path takes 55 (10d10) bludgeoning damage if it isn't being worn or carried.

legendaryActions.name: Rapid Shaping (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The juggernaut recharges Deadly Shaping and uses it.

languages: understands all languages but can't speak

monsters.name: Relentless Slasher
monsters.description: Relentless Slasher from Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.description: If the slasher fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Shrouded Presence
traits.description: The slasher is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, and it can't be detected by abilities that sense Fiends.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The slasher makes two Slasher's Knife attacks.

actions.name: Slasher's Knife
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it suffers a lingering wound that causes it to take 7 (2d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. Each time the slasher hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 3 (1d6). The wound ends if the target regains hit points or if a creature uses an action to stanch the wound, which requires a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

legendaryActions.name: Slice
legendaryActions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

legendaryActions.name: Vanishing Strike (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The slasher makes one Slasher's Knife attack. After the attack hits or misses, the slasher can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

languages: understands all languages but can't speak

monsters.name: Strigoi
monsters.description: Strigoi from Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft.

traits.name: Stirge Telepathy
traits.description: The strigoi can magically command any stirge within 120 feet of it, using a limited form of telepathy.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The strigoi makes one Claw attack and makes one Proboscis attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 6 (1d12) acid damage.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the strigoi regains hit points equal to the amount of necrotic damage dealt. A creature reduced to 0 hit points from this attack dies and leaves nothing behind except its skin and its equipment.

actions.name: Ravenous Children (1/Day)
actions.description: The strigoi magically summons 1d4 + 2 stirges (see their entry in the Monster Manual) in unoccupied spaces it can see within 30 feet of it. The stirges are under the strigoi's control and act immediately after the strigoi in the initiative order. The stirges disappear after 1 hour, when the strigoi dies, or when the strigoi dismisses them (no action required).

monsters.name: Swarm of Gremishkas
monsters.description: Swarm of Gremishkas from Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft.

traits.name: Limited Spell Immunity
traits.description: The swarm automatically succeeds on saving throws against spells of 3rd level or lower, and the attack rolls of such spells always miss it.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny gremishka. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Bites
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer, plus 7 (2d6) force damage.

reactions.name: Spell Redirection
reactions.description: In response to a spell attack roll missing the swarm, the swarm causes that spell to hit another creature of its choice within 30 feet of it that it can see.

monsters.name: Swarm of Maggots
monsters.description: Swarm of Maggots from Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny maggot. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Infestation
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. A creature damaged by the swarm must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or contract a disease. Each time the diseased creature finishes a long rest, roll a d6 to determine the disease's effect: 1-2: The creature is blinded until it finishes a long rest. 3-4: The creature's hit point maximum decreases by 5 (2d4), and the reduction can't be removed until the disease ends. The creature dies if its hit point maximum drops to 0. 5-6: The creature has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls until it finishes its next long rest. The disease lasts until it's removed by magic or until the creature rolls the same random effect for the disease two long rests in a row.

monsters.name: Swarm of Scarabs
monsters.description: Swarm of Scarabs from Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny scarab. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

traits.name: Skeletonize
traits.description: If the swarm starts its turn in the same space as a dead creature that is Large or smaller, the corpse is destroyed, leaving behind only equipment and bones (or exoskeleton).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Ravenous Bites
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. If the target is a creature, scarabs burrow into its body, and the creature takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. Any creature can use an action to kill or remove the scarabs with fire or a weapon that deals piercing damage, causing 1 damage of the appropriate type to the target. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by the swarm's piercing damage dies.

monsters.name: Swarm of Zombie Limbs
monsters.description: Swarm of Zombie Limbs from Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft.
senses: blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 9

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny limb. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The swarm doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The swarm makes one Undead Mass attack and one Grasping Limbs attack.

actions.name: Undead Mass
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

actions.name: Grasping Limbs
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage, and the creature must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be restrained. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 7 (2d6) necrotic damage on a failed save. The creature is freed if it succeeds on this saving throw, the swarm moves out of the creature's space, or the swarm dies.

monsters.name: The Bagman
monsters.description: The Bagman from Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The Bagman has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The Bagman regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the Bagman takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the Bagman's next turn. The Bagman dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.description: The Bagman has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The Bagman can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Alien Mind
traits.description: If a creature tries to read the Bagman's thoughts, that creature must succeed on a DC 8 Intelligence saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute. The stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Bagman makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Unspeakable Horror
monsters.description: Unspeakable Horror from Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft.

traits.name: Formed by the Mists
traits.description: When created, the horror's body composition takes one of four forms: Aberrant Armor, Loathsome Limbs, Malleable Mass, or Oozing Organs. This form determines certain traits in this stat block.

traits.name: Amorphous (Malleable Mass Only)
traits.description: The horror can move through any opening at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Bile Body (Oozing Organs Only)
traits.description: Any creature that touches the horror or hits it with a melee attack takes 5 (1d10) acid damage.

traits.name: Relentless Stride (Loathsome Limbs Only)
traits.description: The horror can move through the space of another creature. The first time on a turn that the horror enters a creature's space during this move, the creature must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The horror makes two Limbs attacks.

actions.name: Limbs
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hex Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The horror expels necrotic energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (7d12) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.name: Vampiric Mind Flayer
monsters.description: Vampiric Mind Flayer from Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The mind flayer can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the mind flayer has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The mind flayer doesn't require air, food, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mind flayer makes two Claw attacks or one Claw attack and one Tentacles attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Drink Sapience
actions.description: The mind flayer targets one creature it is grappling. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 14 (4d6) psychic damage and gain 1 level of exhaustion. The mind flayer regains a number of hit points equal to the psychic damage dealt. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by the psychic damage dies.

bonusActions.name: Disrupt Psyche (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.description: The mind flayer magically emits psionic energy in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or be incapacitated for 1 minute. The incapacitated creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

languages: telepathy 120 ft. but can only project emotions

monsters.name: Wereraven
monsters.description: Wereraven from Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The wereraven can use its action to polymorph into a raven-humanoid hybrid or into a raven, or back into its human form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its human form if it dies.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: The wereraven can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The wereraven regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the wereraven takes damage from a silvered weapon or a spell, this trait doesn't function at the start of the wereraven's next turn. The wereraven dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack (Human or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: The wereraven makes two weapon attacks, one of which can be with its hand crossbow.

actions.name: Beak (Raven or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage in raven form, or 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage in hybrid form. If the target is humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with wereraven lycanthropy.

actions.name: Shortsword (Human or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow (Human or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Zombie Clot
monsters.description: Zombie Clot from Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft.

traits.name: Deathly Stench
traits.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the zombie must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) poison damage and be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The zombie doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zombie makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Flesh Entomb (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The zombie flings a detached clump of corpses at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or take 16 (3d10) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it becomes entombed in dead flesh. A creature entombed in the dead flesh is restrained, has 3 against attacks and other effects outside the dead flesh, and takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The creature can be freed if the dead flesh is destroyed. The dead flesh is a Large object with AC 10, 25 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

monsters.name: Zombie Plague Spreader
monsters.description: Zombie Plague Spreader from Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: The zombie doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Viral Aura
traits.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the plague spreader must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is poisoned and can't regain hit points until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this plague spreader's Viral Aura for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The plague spreader makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Virulent Miasma (1/Day)
actions.description: The plague spreader releases toxic gas in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this damage dies and rises as a zombie (see its stat block in the Monster Manual) 1 minute later. The zombie acts immediately after the plague spreader in the initiative count.

languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
